create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow_graph.Graph instance to build a computational graph with nodes and edges
add_node_to_graph: add a named node to the dataflow graph using graph.add_node
add_edge_between_nodes: add a weighted edge between source and sink nodes using graph.add_edge
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize the dataflow graph to normalize its structure using graph.canonicalize
build_pathological_graph: build a pathological test graph with 16 nodes and 8 weighted edges for graph algorithm testing
